newsitem.title: USA: Interlake Q1 net tumbles after note buyback.
newsitem.headline: Interlake Q1 net tumbles after note buyback.

text.p: Interlake Corp cited a net loss of $1.5 million related to a repurchase of senior notes in the drop in its first-quarter earnings to nil compared to a profit a year ago.

Interlake posted net income of $83,000, or nil per share, versus $2.1 million, or $0.07, in the first quarter of 1996. Sales from continuing operations reached $170.2 million compared to $165.2 million in the same period last year.

The company said the $1.5-million charge stemmed from the repurchase of $14.5 million in senior notes in the period. Year-ago earnings also included a $1.6 million favorable adjustment related to a change in accounting principle for post-retirement life and medical benefits, Interlake said.
Interlake designs and makes products for the material handling, automotive and aerospace industries.
Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 3-1/2.
